ios.desc:
See your event titles in full.

Most calendar apps cut long event titles short. Big Calendar wraps them onto multiple lines, so you can read your whole week at a glance without tapping.

It shows the calendars already on your iPhone, including iCloud, Google and Outlook. No account and nothing to import. Open it and your events are there.

FEATURES

- Full, multi-line event titles
- Clean week view with equal-width days
- Multi-day events shown as bars across the days they cover
- Tap an event to see its details below the calendar
- Create, edit and delete events
- Search your events
- Jump back to today with one tap
- Word replacements to shorten long titles (for example, birthday to bday)
- Choose which calendars show and in what order
- Australian public holidays, filtered by state
- Light and dark mode

FREE AND PRO

Free with a 1 to 2 week view. A one-time Pro purchase unlocks the 3 and 4 week views and month view. No subscription.

PRIVACY

Your events stay on your iPhone. Nothing is collected or shared. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

quotes.text:
I've been using google calendar for over 10 years, but since turning 40 I've found the fonts too small.

So I built an opinionated ios calendar app, "big calendar", that suits my needs.
Big fonts, readable (multi-line) events, wide column for today, etc.
Basically it's for people who don't use timed events much.

It shows whatever is in your apple calendar, so google calendars synced to your iphone show up too.
Now I use it every day, and it has pretty much replaced google calendar for me.

- free to use, with a one-off purchase to unlock more
- not open source
- built with claude (max plan 5x) in vscode/xcode

If you find your calendar too small to read, maybe give it a try. 
Any feedback is appreciated.

https://github.com/minho42/bigcalendar-public
